name: Hoshino Kaoru
source:
She is Yuta's half sister. They started living together two years ago. She dropped out of school due to psychological issues and became a squatting girl at home. She always dresses up in pajamas. She relies heavily on Yuta and hides in fear when she sees people outside of Yuta.

Her hobby island drawing.
